caption:
You've studied and tried — so why does God still feel out of reach? Some things you don't reach by climbing. They have to be opened to you. (Galatians 1:11-12 devotional)

You've studied and strained, treating truth like a summit at the top of your effort. But religion climbs up while the gospel came down — Paul erases “from man” three times, because it wasn't discovered from below; it was opened from above. Even the words are unsealed by their Author, so the first move before Scripture isn't stockpiling knowledge — it's asking, “Open it to me.”

📌 Save this for when the Bible feels shut
📩 Send it to a tired seeker who's been climbing for years
